name: What are the closing costs associated with a cash condo sale?

mainEntity.name: What are the closing costs associated with a cash condo sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closing costs for sellers in a cash condo sale typically include title insurance, transfer taxes, recording fees, and potentially prorated property taxes or HOA dues. While you avoid lender-related fees, other standard closing costs still apply. Kelby Contreras provides a detailed breakdown of estimated seller closing costs specific to your location within Miami-Dade or Broward County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seller closing costs for a cash sale usually cover title insurance, transfer taxes, and recording fees.
